text:
Owen: hi all, I'm Owen (started yesterday). onboarding Qs about my first rotation next week: rota shows me in a different timezone and I can't see the service owners list. who should I ping?
Priya: welcome! timezone bug is a known rota-import issue. ping #eng-infra to refresh your timezone mapping. Marco can also force a sync if needed.
Marco: i can kick the sync. Owen, what's your profile timezone set to in SSO?
Owen: set to Europe/London in SSO profile. rota shows PST.
infra-bot: action: rota_sync_requested for Owen by Marco. Expected completion ~5m.
Jenna: for service owner list, check the service-catalog page (internal link). if an owner is missing, open a small PR to add the contact or ping @SRE-Leads.
Owen: i tried the catalog but the owners column is empty for ingest-service.
Marco: that's because ingest-service recently moved teams. i'll add the new owner mapping now.
OpsShadowBot: scheduled: oncall-shadow session for Owen on Wed 15:00 (staging). Join to run through 'consumer-backpressure' and 'leader-elect' playbooks.
Owen: thanks. what's the recommended practice for timezone handoffs? I might have an 8pm-8am shift overlapping two regions.
Priya: we use a "handoff timezone note" policy. add local times to your /handoff message and mention any running maintenance windows. example: "Handoff: 20:00 UTC (Owen) -> 08:00 PDT (next)"
Jenna: also include the expected quiet period windows and any followups that require business-hours owners.
Owen: who approves suppressions during deploy windows? don't want to mute something important.
Marco: suppressions require a maintenance ticket and an approval from the release manager + oncall-lead. never mute without the ticket link in the alert.
Owen: got it. quick access issue: I can't open secure runbooks (rotate-service-keys). it asks for vault approval.
Priya: secure-runbooks access is gated. submit the access form with manager approval; OpsShadowBot can pre-authorize for shadowing if you indicate 'oncall-shadow'.
Owen: submitted form; OpsShadowBot granted temporary view for staging.
OpsShadowBot: note: temporary_view_granted for Owen until 2025-01-20 23:59 UTC.
Owen: awesome. what are the expectations for post-incident writeups if i handle a page?
Jenna: if you lead remediation, open a short post-incident note within 48 hours: timeline, mitigation steps, followups, owner. tag it with 'oncall-rota' and assign an RCA owner within 3 business days.
Priya: small incidents can use the "short-incident" template. big ones should go through the full RCA process. docs link: https://confluence.redwood/incident-templates
Owen: any 'do not do' for junior oncall ers?
Marco: don't rotate keys or run database failovers alone. if the runbook says "requires 2-person confirmation" follow it. when in doubt, escalate early.
Jenna: also don't edit runbooks during a live incident without a quick PR and an owner to merge. you can add notes in the alert timeline.
Owen: last: if the pager chain is unresponsive (no ack), what's the manual escalation?
Priya: call the oncall-lead phone, escalate to the emergency contact list (SRE-Leads), and open a war-room channel. if it's sev1 and >10m unacked, use the emergency call tree. numbers in pinned messages.
SRE-Leads: adding: if oncall-lead doesn't respond within 10m for sev1, exec-oncall must be paged and a war-room created.
Owen: thanks everyone — i'll join the Wed shadow and DM Marco my SSO username to fix the rota. appreciate the fast replies :slightly_smiling_face:
